messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to simvastatin.
Signs of an allergic reaction to simvastatin include hives, difficult breathing, and swelling in your face or throat.
Get emergency medical help if you have a severe skin reaction.
Signs of a severe skin reaction include fever, sore throat, burning eyes, skin pain, and a red or purple skin rash with blistering and peeling.
Simvastatin can cause the breakdown of muscle tissue.
The breakdown of muscle tissue can lead to kidney failure.
Call your doctor right away if you have unexplained muscle pain.
Call your doctor right away if you have tenderness.
Call your doctor right away if you have weakness.
Call your doctor right away if you have a fever.
Call your doctor right away if you have unusual tiredness.
Call your doctor right away if you have dark urine.
Also call your doctor at once if you have:
signs of a kidney problem - little or no urinating; painful or difficult urination; swelling in your feet or ankles; feeling tired or short of breath; or

The relation 'can lead to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or event may result in the medical condition or event specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'mainly include': The medical condition or event specified by the subject entity primarily consists of the events or conditions specified by the object entity.
B. 'occur regardless of': The medical event or condition specified by the subject entity can happen irrespective of the presence or absence of the factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'may indicate': The subject condition or symptom may be a sign or indicator of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
E. 'has severity': The medical condition or effect specified by the subject has the severity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
